answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the jetty of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the ferrous is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
